---
name: Pull Request
about: Submit changes
---

## What does this PR do?
Brief summary of the changes.

## Related Issue
Closes #

## Type of Change
- [ ] feat: New feature
- [ ] fix: Bug fix
- [ ] chore: Maintenance / tooling
- [ ] docs: Documentation only
- [ ] refactor: No functional change
- [ ] test: Tests only

## Checklist
- [ ] Branch follows naming convention (`feat/`, `fix/`, `chore/`, etc.)
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): description`)
- [ ] All new code has tests
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`flake8`, `black --check`)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Docs/ADR updated if architecture changes
